title: Stop thinking you’re doing something wrong just because it’s hard. The resistance is actually your confirmation. ⚔️
paragraphs: Stop thinking you’re doing something wrong just because it’s hard. The resistance is actually your confirmation. ⚔️

If you feel like you're in the fight of your life right now, it’s not because you've lost your way—it’s because the enemy is terrified of where you are going. You don't guard an empty vault. The thief only attacks the house that holds the treasure.
The intensity of the battle is the greatest indicator of the magnitude of your calling. Stand your ground. If he’s fighting you this hard, you are closer to the breakthrough than you think.
📖 The Word: "No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue which rises against you in judgment You shall condemn." — Isaiah 54:17
Drop a 🔥 if you are ready to fight for your future. Follow @iamGospelWarrior for daily spiritual armor.
